cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put your call on hold, so I've put dinner on hold too. Do I finish your parents' gravy or drive you to the station?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Gravy doesn't pause. It needs stirring now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, keep it moving. Then choose: dinner ready for your parents, or your lift?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finish dinner. I'll book a taxi. Just carry my suitcase downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Case downstairs now, or gravy without lumps? Pick one and I'll do it.
